items.knowledgeNote: आधिकारिक पत्रमा ठेगाना, मिति, विषय, सम्बोधन, निवेदन (के + किन + अनुरोध) र बिदाइ — यी सबै क्रमैसँग राख्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: physics
items.question: Explain the terms ground wave, sky wave and space wave propagation with one suitable use of each.
items.reference:
**Ground wave:** the wave travels along the Earth's surface; useful for medium-wave broadcast over short ranges, attenuated as frequency rises.

**Sky wave:** the wave is refracted back by the ionosphere and can travel thousands of kilometres; used for short-wave radio, but is unstable as ionisation changes with time of day.

**Space wave:** line-of-sight propagation direct from transmitter to receiver (plus a ground-reflected component); used for VHF/UHF TV, radar and satellite links, with range limited by the horizon.
items.knowledgeNote: Satellite communication uses space waves above ~30 MHz, where the ionosphere no longer reflects the signal.

items.subject: biology
items.question: Describe the structure of a nucleotide and explain its role in DNA.
items.reference:
A **nucleotide** = pentose sugar (deoxyribose in DNA) + nitrogenous base (A/T/G/C) + phosphate.

Nucleotides polymerise into strands; two strands coil into the double helix via complementary pairing (A–T, G–C) — the pairing rules that copy genetic information faithfully.
items.knowledgeNote: Sugar + base alone is a nucleoside; add phosphate and it becomes a nucleotide.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: Describe the Ostwald process for nitric acid manufacture.
items.reference:
(1) Catalytic oxidation: 4NH₃ + 5O₂ → 4NO + 6H₂O (Pt–Rh gauze, ~800°C). (2) 2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂. (3) 3NO₂ + H₂O → 2HNO₃ + NO (absorption tower, NO recycled).

Product: ~68% acid, concentrated by distillation.
items.knowledgeNote: Ostwald links Haber (NH₃) to fertilisers and explosives — the nitrogen-industry chain question.

items.subject: english
items.question: What is a logical fallacy? Explain ad hominem and hasty generalisation with one example of each.
items.reference:
A **fallacy** is reasoning that looks valid but isn't.

**Ad hominem:** attacking the person, not the claim — 'Don't trust his tax plan; he failed math.' **Hasty generalisation:** leaping from tiny samples — 'Two tourists were rude, so all tourists are rude.'
items.knowledgeNote: Strawman (distorting the opponent's view) completes the big-three fallacy set for this unit.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: If $a+b+c=0$, then $a^{3}+b^{3}+c^{3}$ is equal to (a) $abc$  (b) $3abc$  (c) $-abc$  (d) $0$
items.reference:
Use the identity
$$a^{3}+b^{3}+c^{3}-3abc=(a+b+c)\left(a^{2}+b^{2}+c^{2}-ab-bc-ca\right)$$
Since $a+b+c=0$, the right-hand side vanishes, so
$$a^{3}+b^{3}+c^{3}=3abc$$
(Sanity check with $a=1,\ b=1,\ c=-2$: $1+1-8=-6$ and $3(1)(1)(-2)=-6$.)

**Correct option: (b) $3abc$**
items.knowledgeNote: $a^{3}+b^{3}+c^{3}=3abc$ whenever $a+b+c=0$ — the single most useful cubic identity.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: 'एकान्तनिवास' कुन साहित्यकारको रचना हो? यो कुन विधाको संग्रह हो र यसमा कुन सामाजिक यथार्थको चित्रण गरिएको छ?
items.reference:
'एकान्तनिवास' **नेमबहादुर हिडी** को रचना हो। यो उनको **निबन्ध संग्रह** हो — कृतिको नाम 'एकान्त + निवास' बाट बनेको हो, जसको अर्थ एकान्तमा बस्नु सङ्केतित गर्छ।

यस संग्रहका निबन्धहरूले **गाउँ र सहरको जीवनको असमानता, गरिबी, शोषण र व्यवस्थापकीय कमजोरी** जस्ता सामाजिक यथार्थको चित्रण गरेका छन्।

यहाँ देखिने प्रमुख साहित्यिक विशेषता — **व्यंग्यात्मक र आलोचनात्मक शैली**। लेखकले सामान्य जीवनका घटनाबाट गहन सामाजिक निष्कर्ष निकाल्न शैली अपनाएका छन्।
items.knowledgeNote: नेमबहादुर हिडीको एकान्तनिवास निबन्ध संग्रहले सामाजिक असमानता र शोषणको यथार्थ चित्रण गर्छ।

items.subject: physics
items.question: A 12 μF capacitor is charged to 100 V. How much energy is stored in it?
items.knowledgeNote: U = ½CV² = Q²/2C = ½QV — pick the form matching the given pair (C,V), (C,Q), or (Q,V).

items.subject: biology
items.question: Explain RNA interference and how it was used to develop nematode-resistant tobacco.
items.reference:
**RNA interference (RNAi)** is a natural cellular defence in which double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) is cut by an enzyme into small interfering RNAs; these bind to the complementary mRNA and prevent its translation, silencing the gene (and the parasite's protein production).

In tobacco, the nematode *Meloidogyne incognita* infects the roots. A dsRNA corresponding to a nematode-specific gene was introduced into the host plant; when the nematode feeds on the plant, the dsRNA is taken up and silences its vital gene, so the parasite cannot survive — the plant becomes **nematode resistant**.
items.knowledgeNote: RNAi silences the parasite's gene, not the plant's — the plant is used only as the delivery vehicle for the dsRNA.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: How will you distinguish between (a) an aldehyde and a ketone, (b) acetaldehyde and benzaldehyde, (c) a carboxylic acid and a phenol?
items.reference:
**(a)** Tollens' reagent gives a silver mirror and Fehling's solution a red-brown Cu₂O precipitate with aldehydes only; ketones do not respond.

**(b)** Iodoform test — acetaldehyde (CH₃CO− group) gives a yellow precipitate of CHI₃ with I₂/NaOH; benzaldehyde does not.

**(c)** Carboxylic acids liberate CO₂ from NaHCO₃ with brisk effervescence; phenols do not (phenol dissolves only in NaOH).
items.knowledgeNote: The iodoform test detects the CH₃CO− group or a CH₃CH(OH)− group, so it also identifies ethanol and methyl ketones.

items.subject: english
items.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentences: (a) Neither the teacher nor the students ___ (was/were) informed. (b) The meeting was postponed ___ (because of/due to) heavy rain. (c) She is used to ___ (work/working) late.
items.reference:
(a) **were** — with 'neither … nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject 'students' (plural).

(b) **because of** — 'because of' is a two-word preposition followed by a noun phrase; 'due to' typically follows the verb 'be' (the postponement was due to rain).

(c) **working** — 'be used to' is followed by a gerund (accustomed to it), unlike 'used to work' (past habit).
items.knowledgeNote: The distinction between 'used to + infinitive' (past habit) and 'be used to + gerund' (accustomed) is a favourite grammar item.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: Find dy/dx if x = a(θ − sin θ) and y = a(1 − cos θ).
items.reference:
dx/dθ = a(1 − cosθ), dy/dθ = a sinθ.

dy/dx = (dy/dθ)/(dx/dθ) = a sinθ / a(1 − cosθ) = sinθ/(1 − cosθ).

Using the half-angle identities: = [2 sin(θ/2)cos(θ/2)]/[2 sin²(θ/2)] = **cot(θ/2)**. At θ = π/2 the slope is cot(π/4) = 1.
items.knowledgeNote: For parametric curves always divide the derivatives, and simplify with half-angle identities — the cycloid slope simplification is a standard question.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: विद्यालयमा सम्पन्न 'विविधावर प्रतियोगिता' को प्रतिवेदन तयार गर्नुहोस्।
items.reference:
**प्रतिवेदन**

**विषय:** वार्षिक विविधावर प्रतियोगिता २०८१
**समय:** २०८१ कार्तिक १५, बिहान १० बजे
**स्थान:** विद्यालय सभाहल

**पृष्ठभूमि र उद्देश्य:** विद्यार्थीको प्रस्तुतीकरण क्षमता, भाषिक दक्षता र आत्मविश्वास बढाउने उद्देश्यले आयोजना गरिएको।

**कार्यक्रमको विवरण:** कुल ४२ प्रतिस्पर्धी; खण्ड — हास्य कविता, भाषण, कथा कथन, फुटकर गीत। तीनजना शिक्षक निर्णायक।

**नतिजा:** प्रथम — सुश्री अनुशा, द्वितीय — श्री सुजन; द्वितीय कक्षाकी छात्राले दर्शकको मन जितेको।

**समस्या:** समय व्यवस्थापनको कमजोरीले दुई खण्ड संक्षिप्त गर्नुपर्‍यो; सभाहलमा ध्वनि प्रणाली पर्याप्त थिएन।

**सुझाव:** अर्को वर्ष अग्रिम समय-तालिका, राम्रो ध्वनि प्रणाली र प्रतिस्पर्धीलाई पूर्व अभ्यासको अवसर।

प्रतिवेदन तयार गर्ने — सचिव, सांस्कृतिक समिति।
items.knowledgeNote: प्रतिवेदनमा भावना नभई तथ्य — उद्देश्य, विवरण, नतिजा, समस्या र सुझावको क्रम अपनाउनुहोस्।

items.subject: physics
items.question: Define bandwidth of a signal and calculate the bandwidth needed if a message of 5 kHz is transmitted by (a) AM and (b) FM with a frequency deviation of 20 kHz.
items.reference:
**Bandwidth** is the range of frequencies a signal occupies.

**(a) AM:** 2f_m = 2 × 5 = **10 kHz**.

**(b) FM:** 2(f_m + Δf) = 2(5 + 20) = **50 kHz**, using Carson's rule.
items.knowledgeNote: FM needs a wider channel than AM but trades bandwidth for noise immunity — a recurring NEB comparison.

items.subject: biology
items.question: Describe the salient features of the Watson-Crick model of DNA.
items.reference: (1) Two antiparallel polynucleotide strands coiled into a **double helix**. (2) Sugar–phosphate backbone outside, bases inside. (3) Complementary pairing: A=T (2 H-bonds), G≡C (3 H-bonds). (4) Diameter ~20 Å with one full turn per 34 Å (10 base pairs). (5) Right-handed helix.
items.knowledgeNote: Chargaff's rules (A=T, G=C) were the data Watson and Crick built the model to fit.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: Describe the Solvay process for sodium carbonate manufacture with reactions.
items.reference:
Brine + ammonia + CO₂: NaCl + NH₃ + CO₂ + H₂O → NaHCO₃↓ + NH₄Cl; then 2NaHCO₃ →(heat) Na₂CO₃ + CO₂ + H₂O.

Ammonia is regenerated from NH₄Cl with lime, and CO₂ from limestone calcination — only limestone and brine are consumed.
items.knowledgeNote: Fails for K₂CO₃ (KHCO₃ too soluble to precipitate) — the built-in limitation question.

items.subject: english
items.question: Write any four criteria for evaluating the credibility of an information source.
items.reference: (1) **Authority** — qualified author/publisher? (2) **Evidence** — data and citations, or bare claims? (3) **Currency** — recent enough for the topic? (4) **Objectivity** — balanced or pushing an agenda? (+ Purpose: inform vs sell.)
items.knowledgeNote: Lateral reading — checking what OTHER reputable sites say about a source — beats judging any site by its own design.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: Factorise $2x^{3}-3x^{2}-10x+15$. Hence solve the equation $2x^{3}-3x^{2}-10x+15=0$.
items.knowledgeNote: Factorising by grouping gives $(2x-3)(x^{2}-5)$; always split the difference of squares to get the linear factors.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: नाटक भनेको के हो? नाटकका मुख्य अङ्गहरू नाम लेख्नुहोस् र नाटक अन्य साहित्यिक विधाभन्दा भिन्न किन हुन्छ भनी स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
items.reference:
**नाटकको परिभाषा:** नाटक भनेको त्यस्तो साहित्यिक रचना हो जसमा पात्रहरूको **अभिनय** मार्फत घटना–क्रम अगाडि बढ्छ र जीवनयापरको यथार्थ, आचरण वा समस्या प्रस्तुत गरिन्छ।

**नाटकका मुख्य अङ्गहरू:**
1. **दृश्य (वातावरण)** — काल, स्थान, वस्तु–स्थिति र परिस्थिति बुझाउने
2. **संवाद (भाषा)** — चरित्रको भावना, सम्बन्ध र कारण प्रकट गर्ने
3. **अभिनय** — पात्रको मुख, हात, शरीर र स्वरबाट भाव प्रकट गराउने
4. **अलङ्कार**
5. **वेशभूषा**
6. **सङ्गीत**
7. **प्रवेश–निर्गमद्वार** (पात्रको प्रवेश र निर्गमको ठाउँ)

**भिन्नता:** नाटक **अभिनययोग्य** साहित्यिक विधा हो — यो मञ्चमा देखाउन मिल्ने भाषा, अङ्ग र दृश्य यसका अनिवार्य तत्त्व हुन्। कथा, कविता र निबन्ध पढ्ने वा सुन्दा मात्र बुझिने भए पनि नाटकलाई अभिनय गरेर नै यसको पूर्ण अर्थ बुझ्न सकिन्छ।
items.knowledgeNote: नाटक अभिनययोग्य विधा हो, जसका मुख्य अङ्गमा दृश्य, संवाद, अभिनय, अलङ्कार, वेशभूषा र सङ्गीत पर्छन्।

items.subject: physics
items.question: What is a dielectric? Explain how inserting a dielectric slab increases the capacitance of a capacitor.
items.reference:
A **dielectric** is an insulating material whose molecules polarise in an electric field.

The induced surface charges oppose the plate charges, weakening the internal field E. Since V = Ed falls while Q stays fixed, C = Q/V **rises by the dielectric constant εᵣ** (C = εᵣC₀).
items.knowledgeNote: Battery connected (V fixed) vs isolated (Q fixed) give opposite energy answers — always check which is held constant.

items.subject: biology
items.question: What are restriction enzymes? Explain their role in recombinant DNA technology with reference to palindromic sequences.
items.reference:
**Restriction enzymes (restriction endonucleases)** are molecular scissors that cut double-stranded DNA at specific recognition sites. They are named after the bacterium from which they are isolated — EcoRI comes from *Escherichia coli*, RY13, strain I.

Each enzyme recognises a **palindromic** base sequence (reading the same 5′→3′ on both strands, e.g. GAATTC/CTTAAG for EcoRI) and cuts between the same two bases on both strands, leaving **sticky ends** — short single-stranded overhangs.

In rDNA technology the same enzyme cuts both the vector (e.g. pBR322) and the foreign DNA, so the complementary sticky ends base-pair; **DNA ligase** then seals the phosphodiester backbone to give recombinant DNA, which can be cloned in a host.
items.knowledgeNote: Sticky ends make ligation efficient; the same enzyme for vector and insert is the key design rule of cloning.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: Arrange the primary, secondary and tertiary amines in the order of basicity in aqueous solution and explain the order.
items.reference:
In aqueous solution: **(C₂H₅)₂NH > (C₂H₅)₃N ≈ C₂H₅NH₂ > NH₃** for ethylamines.

The observed order is a balance of two opposing factors: the **+I effect** of alkyl groups increases electron density on nitrogen (raising basicity as the number of alkyl groups grows), while **solvation/stabilisation of the conjugate acid** (hydrogen bonding with water) decreases as N−H hydrogens are replaced, and steric hindrance around the lone pair reduces protonation for tertiary amines.
items.knowledgeNote: In the gas phase basicity simply follows the +I effect: 3° > 2° > 1° > NH₃ — the reversal in water is the favourite NEB trap.

items.subject: english
items.question: Discuss the theme of Anita Desai's story 'A Devoted Son'.
items.reference:
The story dramatises the clash between traditional duty and modern success through Rakesh and his father Varma.

**Devotion and its cost:** Rakesh is the ideal son — top of his class, a doctor, caring — yet his very devotion confines his father: the old man is put on a strict diet and regimen that keeps him alive but strips him of the pleasures (rich food, oil, spice) that made life worth living. The father's protest — 'I'm not a child' — exposes the difference between keeping a person alive and letting them live.

**Generational inversion:** the son becomes the parent, the father the dependent child, and affection inverts into control. Desai shows that duty without empathy can be a form of cruelty, and that successful children may leave their parents emotionally orphaned. The story leaves the reader to judge who is truly devoted.
items.knowledgeNote: Answer a theme question with a clear statement, two or three supporting incidents, and a judgement — avoid retelling the whole plot.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: Evaluate: (a) ∫ x eˣ dx, (b) ∫ dx/(x² − 4).
items.reference:
**(a) By parts** (∫u dv = uv − ∫v du): take u = x, dv = eˣdx → du = dx, v = eˣ.

∫x eˣ dx = x eˣ − ∫eˣ dx = **x eˣ − eˣ + C = eˣ(x − 1) + C**.

**(b) Partial fractions:** 1/(x² − 4) = 1/[(x − 2)(x + 2)] = (1/4)[1/(x − 2) − 1/(x + 2)].

So ∫dx/(x² − 4) = **(1/4) ln|(x − 2)/(x + 2)| + C** (using ∫dx/(x − a) = ln|x − a|).
items.knowledgeNote: For by-parts choose u by the ILATE order (Inverse, Log, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential) — here the algebraic x is u.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: 'आमाको सपना' कविताको केन्द्रीय भाव लेख्नुहोस्।
items.reference:
कवि गोपालप्रसाद रिमालको 'आमाको सपना' कविताको केन्द्रीय भाव **सन्तानको उन्नतिप्रति आमाको निःस्वार्थ ममता र त्याग** हो।

कवितामा आमा आफ्नो सम्पूर्ण जीवन छोराको भविष्यका लागि बिताउँछिन्; शिक्षा र सभ्य बनाउने उनको सपना छोरोको सफलतासँग जोडिएको छ। दुःख, गरिबी र असहाय अवस्थामा पनि उनको आशा मर्दैन — छोरोले उज्यालो बाटो समात्ने विश्वास उनमा कायम रहन्छ।

कविताको प्रतिपाद्य हो: मातृ-स्नेह निःस्वार्थ हुन्छ र सन्तानको कर्तव्य आमाको त्याग बुझेर आफ्नो जिम्मेवारी पूरा गर्नु हो। सरल भाषा, दोहोरिने लय र मार्मिक बिम्बले भावलाई प्रभावकारी बनाएका छन्।
items.knowledgeNote: कविताको उत्तरमा विधा, रचनाकार, मूल भाव, प्रतिपाद्य र शिल्प — यी पाँच बुँदा राख्दा पूर्णाङ्क पाइन्छ।

items.subject: physics
items.question: Define drift velocity and derive the relation I = neAv_d for a conductor.
items.reference:
**Drift velocity** is the average velocity with which free electrons move opposite the field.

In time t, electrons travel v_d·t, so all electrons in a cylinder of volume A·v_d·t cross the section. Number = n·A·v_d·t carrying charge q = ne·A·v_d·t.

I = q/t = **neAv_d**. Since v_d = eEτ/m, also I = ne²AτE/m.
items.knowledgeNote: Drift speed is only ~10⁻⁴ m s⁻¹ while the signal travels near light speed — the field, not the electron, carries the message.

items.subject: biology
items.question: What are enzymes? Write any four of their properties.
items.reference:
**Enzymes** are protein biocatalysts that speed reactions without being consumed.

(1) Highly specific (lock-and-key / induced fit). (2) Work best at optimum T and pH. (3) Needed in tiny amounts; reusable. (4) Lower activation energy. (5) Inhibited by poisons (cyanide, heavy metals).
items.knowledgeNote: Apoenzyme (protein) + cofactor (metal/vitamin) = holoenzyme — the complete active form.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: What are NPK fertilisers? Why is urea the most widely used nitrogenous fertiliser?
items.reference:
**NPK** fertilisers supply nitrogen (leaf growth), phosphorus (roots/flowers), potassium (disease resistance).

**Urea** (46.7% N, highest of all) is cheap, highly soluble, non-explosive, and leaves only CO₂ — dominating Nepal's Terai paddy cultivation.
items.knowledgeNote: Excess N runs off into rivers (eutrophication) — the environmental counterpoint NEB pairs with this question.

items.subject: english
items.question: Distinguish between observation and inference with an example.
items.reference:
**Observation** reports direct senses: 'The classroom floor is wet.' **Inference** explains it: '…so the roof must be leaking (or someone spilled water).'

Observations are checkable facts; inferences are best-guess explanations — science advances by testing inferences against new observations.
items.knowledgeNote: Multiple inferences can fit one observation — listing alternatives before concluding is the critical habit.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: Find the equation of the circle passing through the points $(0,-2)$, $(-4,0)$ and $(3,0)$. Hence find its centre and radius.
items.reference:
Let the circle be
$$x^{2}+y^{2}+Dx+Ey+F=0$$
Substituting the three given points:

- $(0,-2):\quad 4-2E+F=0 \quad\cdots(i)$
- $(-4,0):\quad 16-4D+F=0 \quad\cdots(ii)$
- $(3,0):\quad 9+3D+F=0 \quad\cdots(iii)$

Subtracting $(iii)$ from $(ii)$:
$$7-7D=0\implies D=1$$
From $(iii)$: $9+3+F=0\implies F=-12$.
From $(i)$: $4-2E-12=0\implies E=-4$.

**Equation of the circle:**
$$x^{2}+y^{2}+x-4y-12=0$$

**Centre:** $\left(-\frac{D}{2},-\frac{E}{2}\right)=\left(-\frac12,\,2\right)$

**Radius:**
$$r=\sqrt{\frac{D^{2}}{4}+\frac{E^{2}}{4}-F}=\sqrt{\frac14+4+12}=\sqrt{\frac{65}{4}}=\frac{\sqrt{65}}{2}\approx 4.03$$

Check: $(3,0):9+3-12=0$; $(-4,0):16-4-12=0$; $(0,-2):4+8-12=0$.
items.knowledgeNote: For $x^{2}+y^{2}+Dx+Ey+F=0$ the centre is $\left(-\frac{D}{2},-\frac{E}{2}\right)$ and $r=\sqrt{\frac{D^{2}+E^{2}}{4}-F}$.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: निम्नमध्ये लेखक र कृतिको जोडी सही कुन हो? (क) सानेपाखि — नेमबहादुर हिडी (ख) माटोको टिप्परी — टकरबहादुर राई (ग) भँडारी — अमर नेपाल (घ) रूपसू — बुद्धभक्ति आचार्य
items.reference:
**सही उत्तर: (क) सानेपाखि — नेमबहादुर हिडी**

'सानेपाखि' नेमबहादुर हिडीको प्रसिद्ध **कथासङ्ग्रह** हो।

अन्य विकल्पका सही जोडी:
- **(ख)** माटोको टिप्परी — **रुद्रबहादुर राई** (टकरबहादुर राई होइनन्)।
- **(ग)** भँडारी — **हरिमाल** (अमर नेपाल होइनन्)।
- **(घ)** रूपसू — **सकुन्तला** (बुद्धभक्ति आचार्य होइनन्)।
items.knowledgeNote: नेमबहादुर हिडीले सानेपाखि (कथा) र एकान्तनिवास (निबन्ध) दुई विधाकै लेखनीय कृति लेखेका छन्।

items.subject: physics
items.question: Write any four uses of capacitors.
items.reference: (1) Smoothing/filtering ripples in power supplies. (2) Tuning radio circuits (with an inductor). (3) Storing the firing energy in camera flashes and defibrillators. (4) Power-factor correction in factories; (5) blocking DC while passing AC between amplifier stages.
items.knowledgeNote: Every use exploits one property: capacitors store charge, block DC, and pass AC.

items.subject: biology
items.question: Describe the polymerase chain reaction and state its three steps with the enzymes used.
items.reference:
**PCR** amplifies a specific DNA segment in vitro, producing billions of copies.

**Steps (each cycle):**
1. **Denaturation** — heat to about 94 °C so the double helix separates into single strands.
2. **Annealing** — cool to about 50–60 °C so synthetic primers (short oligonucleotides complementary to the ends) bind to each strand.
3. **Extension** — raise to about 72 °C, where **Taq polymerase** (from *Thermus aquaticus*) extends the primers using dNTPs.

Repeat for 30–35 cycles: the target multiplies about 2ⁿ times. Uses: diagnosis of infections and genetic disorders, DNA fingerprinting, and amplifying a gene before cloning.
items.knowledgeNote: Taq polymerase is used because it survives the high denaturation temperature — a thermolabile enzyme would be destroyed each cycle.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: Describe the Hinsberg test and use it to distinguish between primary, secondary and tertiary amines.
items.reference:
Benzenesulphonyl chloride (C₆H₅SO₂Cl) reacts in aqueous alkali:

- **Primary amine:** forms a mono-substituted sulphonamide with an acidic N−H, so it dissolves in alkali to give a clear solution (soluble in KOH).
- **Secondary amine:** forms a di-substituted sulphonamide with no acidic hydrogen — insoluble in alkali, giving a precipitate.
- **Tertiary amine:** no reaction at all (no N−H to replace) and no precipitate; it remains as the free amine, distinguishable by odour and by its failure to react.
items.knowledgeNote: Hinsberg's reagent separates the three classes in one test; the carbylamine (Hofmann isocyanide) test confirms a primary amine specifically.

items.subject: english
items.question: Explain the significance of the title of Manjushree Thapa's story 'The Half-closed Eyes of the Buddha and the Slowly Sinking Sun'.
items.reference:
The title is richly symbolic.

**The Buddha's eyes** represent the eternal watchful presence of tradition and moral order over the Kathmandu valley; because they are 'half-closed', the divine gaze seems tolerant, but also indifferent or unwilling to intervene in the world below.

**The slowly sinking sun** suggests decline — the fading of a rich cultural landscape, of deference to the old, and of the country's beauty under modern pressures. The two images together capture the story's central tension: a sacred heritage that observes but cannot stop the erosion of its own culture, and a tourist or modern gaze that consumes what it admires.

The title thus frames the story as an elegy — a lament for a valley whose glory is waning under the very sun that once illuminated it.
items.knowledgeNote: Title questions reward unpacking each image separately, then showing how they combine into the story's meaning.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: Evaluate ∫₀^(π/2) sin²x dx.
items.reference:
Use the identity sin²x = (1 − cos2x)/2:

∫sin²x dx = ∫(1 − cos2x)/2 dx = x/2 − sin2x/4.

Applying the limits 0 to π/2: [π/4 − 0] − [0 − 0] = **π/4 ≈ 0.785**.

(Check by symmetry: ∫₀^(π/2) sin²x dx = ∫₀^(π/2) cos²x dx, and their sum is π/2, so each is π/4.)
items.knowledgeNote: Reducing powers with double-angle identities converts a definite trigonometric integral into elementary terms — the standard NEB approach.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: 'एक चिहान' उपन्यासको सामाजिक सन्देश के हो? छोटो विश्लेषण गर्नुहोस्।
items.reference:
पारिजातको 'एक चिहान' नेपाली समाजको यथार्थ चित्रण गर्ने उपन्यास हो। यसको सामाजिक सन्देश — **अन्धविश्वास, छुवाछूत, लिङ्ग-विभेद र हिंसाले सिङ्गो समाजलाई कसरी क्षय गर्छ भन्ने चेतावनी** हो।

उपन्यासमा सुकुम्बासी/समानान्तर बस्तीका पात्र, बोक्सीको आरोप, रुढी परम्परा र स्त्रीको असहाय अवस्था देखाइएको छ। अजम्बरी निर्दोष भएर पनि इलाका र सामाजिक शक्तिको शिकार हुन्छिन्; माधवको सङ्घर्ष संरचनासँग ठोकिन्छ।

सन्देश दुईतिर छ: पहिलो, विभेद गर्ने परम्परा त्याग्नु; दोस्रो, अन्यायविरुद्ध प्रतिरोध गर्नु। 'चिहान' नै उपन्यासको प्रतीक हो — एक आमाको र एक समाजको सामूहिक चिहान, जसले विस्मृतिको मूल्य देखाउँछ।
items.knowledgeNote: उपन्यासको प्रश्नमा कथानक मात्र नभनी पात्र-चरित्र, प्रतीक र समकालीन सान्दर्भिकता जोड्नुहोस्।

items.subject: physics
items.question: State Kirchhoff's laws for electric circuits and use them to obtain the balance condition of a Wheatstone bridge.
items.reference:
**Junction rule:** sum of currents entering = sum leaving (charge conservation). **Loop rule:** algebraic sum of potential changes round any closed loop is zero (energy conservation).

For the bridge, at balance no current flows through the galvanometer, so current divides into P,Q and R,S branches: I₁P = I₂R and I₁Q = I₂S. Dividing,

**P/Q = R/S** — the balance condition.
items.knowledgeNote: At balance the galvanometer branch may be removed or replaced by any resistance without changing the currents — the basis of the metre bridge.

items.subject: biology
items.question: Classify carbohydrates with one example of each class.
items.reference: **Monosaccharides** (single sugars): glucose, fructose. **Oligosaccharides** (2–10 units): sucrose, maltose. **Polysaccharides** (many units): starch, cellulose, glycogen.
items.knowledgeNote: Glucose = instant energy; starch/glycogen = storage; cellulose = structure — function follows polymerisation.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: How is cement manufactured? What happens during the setting of cement?
items.reference:
Limestone + clay are burnt at ~1500°C to clinker (calcium silicates/aluminates), then ground with ~3% gypsum.

**Setting:** hydration of silicates forms interlocking C–S–H gel crystals; gypsum regulates the flash set of aluminates. Final hardening takes days as the gel densifies.
items.knowledgeNote: Gypsum retards, never accelerates — its absence would flash-set cement unusably fast.

items.subject: english
items.question: Change into passive voice: 'The teacher gave the students homework.'
items.reference:
**Passive:** The students were given homework by the teacher.

Rule: Object becomes subject; verb becomes 'be + past participle'; original subject becomes 'by + agent'.
items.knowledgeNote: Double object sentences: either object can become subject in passive voice.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: The length of the latus rectum of the parabola $y^{2}=12x$ is (a) 3  (b) 6  (c) 12  (d) 4
items.reference:
Compare $y^{2}=12x$ with the standard form $y^{2}=4ax$:
$$4a=12 \implies a=3$$
The length of the latus rectum is $4a$, so
$$4a=4(3)=12$$

**Correct option: (c) 12**
items.knowledgeNote: For $y^{2}=4ax$ the latus rectum has length $4a$ and passes through the focus $(a,0)$.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: कथा भनेको के हो? कथाका प्रमुख तत्त्वहरूको वर्णन गर्नुहोस्।
items.reference:
**कथा** छोटो गद्य रचना हो जसले एउटै घटना, सीमित पात्र र एक निश्चित उद्देश्य प्रस्तुत गर्छ।

**तत्त्वहरू:** (१) कथावस्तु/कथानक, (२) पात्र र चरित्र-चित्रण, (३) संवाद, (४) देशकाल-वातावरण, (५) भाषा-शैली, (६) उद्देश्य/सन्देश।
items.knowledgeNote: कथा एक बसाइमा पढिसक्नुपर्छ — संक्षिप्तता नै यसको प्राण हो।

items.subject: physics
items.question: Define centripetal acceleration. Derive an expression for it.
items.reference:
**Centripetal acceleration** is the acceleration directed toward the center of a circular path. Derivation:

Consider a particle moving in a circle of radius r with uniform speed v. In time Î”t, it moves through angle Î”Î¸.
Change in velocity Î”v â‰ˆ v Î”Î¸ (for small Î”Î¸)
Acceleration a = Î”v/Î”t = v(Î”Î¸/Î”t) = vÏ‰ = v(v/r) = **vÂ²/r**

Alternatively: a = Ï‰Â²r where Ï‰ is angular velocity.
items.knowledgeNote: Centripetal force F = mvÂ²/r = mÏ‰Â²r always directed toward center. Not a new forceâ€”just net force providing centripetal acceleration.

items.subject: biology
items.question: Explain gel electrophoresis and the techniques used to visualise separated DNA fragments.
items.reference:
**Gel electrophoresis** separates DNA fragments according to size. DNA is negatively charged, so in an electric field it migrates towards the anode through an agarose gel; **smaller fragments move farther**, larger ones lag near the well.

The separated bands are visualised by staining with **ethidium bromide** followed by exposure to **UV light**, where the DNA–dye complex fluoresces bright orange. A known marker (ladder) run alongside identifies fragment sizes.

The separated band of interest is then cut from the gel and the DNA eluted (recovered) — this **elution** step purifies the fragment for use in cloning or sequencing.
items.knowledgeNote: The gel acts as a molecular sieve: pore size and agarose concentration decide the range of sizes resolved.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: Write the reactions involved in the preparation and synthetic use of diazonium salts from aniline.
items.knowledgeNote: Coupling of the diazonium ion with phenol or an aromatic amine gives the intensely coloured azo compounds — the key commercial use.

items.subject: english
items.question: What is the central message of Ben Okri's poem 'The Awakening Age'? How does the poem argue for hope?
items.reference:
The poem speaks of a world emerging from long suffering into a new consciousness. Its central message is that **history's wounds — war, poverty, oppression — need not define the future: an 'awakening age' is possible if people choose hope, attention and shared aspiration over cynicism.**

Okri argues for hope not as optimism but as a disciplined act: the poet invites the reader to believe the light, to fight for the real riches of life, and to love, since every act of hope is a small renewal. The final lines suggest that a wakeful people can begin the world again. The poem's call is therefore collective: hope is the first form of courage, and it is chosen, not given.
items.knowledgeNote: Quote a short phrase from the poem in your answer — it shows close reading and lifts a 4-mark response.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: Evaluate ∫ dx/(1 + cos x).
items.reference:
Use 1 + cos x = 2cos²(x/2):

∫ dx/(1 + cosx) = ∫ dx/(2cos²(x/2)) = (1/2)∫ sec²(x/2) dx = (1/2)·2 tan(x/2) + C = **tan(x/2) + C**.

So the integral is tan(x/2) + C (valid where cos(x/2) ≠ 0).
items.knowledgeNote: Half-angle identities turn rational trigonometric integrands into standard sec² forms — remember ∫sec²u du = tan u.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: 'हामीलाई बोलाउँछन् हिमचुली' कविताको भाव र शिल्प (लय, बिम्ब, अलंकार) को चर्चा गर्नुहोस्।
items.reference:
भूपी शेरचनको यो कविता **प्रकृतिको आह्वानमार्फत मानवीय कर्तव्य जगाउने** कविता हो। हिमचुली (हिउँका टाकुरा) ले मानिसलाई जीवनको मूल उद्देश्य — श्रम, साहस र नवनिर्माणतर्फ बोलाउँछन्; आराम र निष्क्रियता त्याग्न आग्रह गर्छन्।

**शिल्प:**
- **लय:** मुक्त छन्दको प्रवाह, दोहोरिने आह्वानात्मक पङ्क्तिले गति दिन्छ।
- **बिम्ब:** हिमचुली, पहाड, उकालो — उचाइ र पवित्रताको प्रतीक।
- **अलंकार:** मानवीकरण (हिमचुलीले 'बोलाउनु') र प्रतीकात्मकता प्रमुख।

कविताले पाठकलाई आत्मबल र सामूहिक श्रमको सन्देश दिन्छ — उचाइ चढ्नु नै अग्रगामी यात्राको रूपक हो।
items.knowledgeNote: शिल्प सोधिएको प्रश्नमा लय, बिम्ब, अलंकार र भाषा छुट्टाछुट्टै उल्लेख गर्दा पूर्णाङ्क सम्भव हुन्छ।

items.subject: physics
items.question: A cell of emf 2 V and internal resistance 0.5 Ω is connected to a 3.5 Ω resistor. Calculate the current in the circuit and the terminal potential difference across the cell.
items.knowledgeNote: Terminal voltage is always less than emf while discharging; it equals emf only in an open circuit (I = 0).

items.subject: biology
items.question: Distinguish between saturated and unsaturated fatty acids. Why do phospholipids form bilayers in water?
items.reference:
**Saturated** acids have only single bonds (straight chains, solid fats like ghee); **unsaturated** have C=C kinks (oils like mustard oil).

Phospholipids are amphipathic — hydrophilic heads face water on both sides while hydrophobic tails hide inside — so a **bilayer** is the lowest-energy arrangement, forming every cell membrane.
items.knowledgeNote: The bilayer's fluid mosaic (Singer–Nicolson) explains selective permeability and membrane protein movement.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: Give the reaction of benzene with (a) a mixture of concentrated nitric and sulphuric acids, (b) fuming sulphuric acid, and (c) chlorine in the presence of anhydrous aluminium chloride. State the conditions for each.
items.reference:
**(a) Nitration — at about 323 K (50 °C), concentrated HNO₃ with concentrated H₂SO₄ as catalyst:**

$$\text{C}_6\text{H}_6 + \text{HNO}_3 \xrightarrow[50^\circ\text{C}]{\text{conc. H}_2\text{SO}_4} \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{NO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

Nitrobenzene is formed (an electrophilic substitution).

**(b) Sulphonation — with fuming (oleum) sulphuric acid at 100 °C:**

$$\text{C}_6\text{H}_6 + \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \xrightarrow{100^\circ\text{C},\ \text{fuming}} \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{SO}_3\text{H} + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

Benzenesulphonic acid is formed; the reverse reaction occurs on dilution with water.

**(c) Halogenation — chlorine passed in the presence of anhydrous AlCl₃ catalyst:**

$$\text{C}_6\text{H}_6 + \text{Cl}_2 \xrightarrow{\text{anh. AlCl}_3} \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{Cl} + \text{HCl}$$

Chlorobenzene is produced. The halogen must be dry, otherwise water hydrolyses the AlCl₃ catalyst and the reaction stops.
items.knowledgeNote: Nitration needs conc. HNO₃/H₂SO₄ at 323 K, sulphonation needs fuming H₂SO₄, and chlorination needs anhydrous AlCl₃.

items.subject: english
items.question: Fill in the blanks with correct tense: 'By the time we reached the station, the train ___ (already/leave).'
items.reference:
'By the time we reached the station, the train **had already left**.'

Rule: Past perfect tense for the earlier action when two past actions are mentioned.
items.knowledgeNote: Past perfect (had + V3) is used for the action completed before another past action.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: A straight line passes through the point $(1,3)$ and cuts off an intercept of 7 units from the x-axis. Find its equation. Hence find the perpendicular distance of the point $(2,-1)$ from this line.
items.reference:
An intercept of 7 on the x-axis means the line passes through $(7,0)$.

**Slope:**
$$m=\frac{3-0}{1-7}=\frac{3}{-6}=-\frac{1}{2}$$

**Equation** using $(7,0)$:
$$y-0=-\frac{1}{2}(x-7)\implies 2y=-x+7$$
$$\boxed{x+2y-7=0}$$

**Perpendicular distance** of $(2,-1)$ from $x+2y-7=0$:
$$d=\frac{|1(2)+2(-1)-7|}{\sqrt{1^{2}+2^{2}}}=\frac{|2-2-7|}{\sqrt{5}}=\frac{7}{\sqrt{5}}=\frac{7\sqrt{5}}{5}\approx 3.13$$

(Check the line: $(1,3)\to 1+6-7=0$ and $(7,0)\to 7-7=0$.)
items.knowledgeNote: Distance from $(x_{1},y_{1})$ to $Ax+By+C=0$ is $\frac{|Ax_{1}+By_{1}+C|}{\sqrt{A^{2}+B^{2}}}$.

items.subject: nepali
items.question: एकाङ्की र पूर्णाङ्की नाटकबीच कुनै तीन भिन्नता लेख्नुहोस्।
items.reference: (१) **एकाङ्की** एउटै अङ्कको, छोटो; **पूर्णाङ्की** धेरै अङ्कको, लामो। (२) एकाङ्कीमा एउटै घटना र सीमित पात्र; पूर्णाङ्कीमा उपकथा र धेरै पात्र। (३) एकाङ्की छोटो समयमा मञ्चन हुन्छ; पूर्णाङ्कीलाई घण्टौँ लाग्छ।
items.knowledgeNote: एकाङ्की = कथाको नाट्य रूप; पूर्णाङ्की = उपन्यासको नाट्य रूप।

items.subject: physics
items.question: A flywheel of radius 0.5 m rotates at a constant speed of 300 revolutions per minute. Find its angular velocity, the linear speed of a point on the rim and the centripetal acceleration there.
items.reference:
**Step 1 — Convert rpm to rad/s:**
$$\omega = \frac{300 \times 2\pi}{60} = \frac{600\pi}{60} = 10\pi$$
$$\omega = \mathbf{31.4\ \text{rad/s}}$$

**Step 2 — Linear (tangential) speed** of a point on the rim:
$$v = \omega r = 31.4 \times 0.5$$
$$\boxed{v = \mathbf{15.7\ \text{m/s}}\approx 15.7\ \text{m/s}}$$

**Step 3 — Centripetal acceleration:**
$$a_c = \frac{v^2}{r} = \omega^2 r$$
$$a_c = \frac{(15.7)^2}{0.5} = \frac{246.49}{0.5} = 492.98\ \text{m/s}^2$$
$$\boxed{a_c \approx \mathbf{493\ \text{m/s}^2}}$$

**Direction:** The acceleration is directed **towards the centre** (along the radius) and hence is a centripetal acceleration; its magnitude stays constant while the velocity direction changes continuously.
items.knowledgeNote: Angular velocity equals 2 pi n over 60, linear speed equals omega times radius, and centripetal acceleration equals omega squared times radius.

items.subject: biology
items.question: Explain the greenhouse effect and global warming, naming the main greenhouse gases and their major sources.
items.reference:
**Greenhouse effect:** the atmosphere transmits incoming short-wave solar radiation but traps the longer-wave infrared radiation re-emitted by the earth, keeping the surface warm. It is natural and essential — without it the earth would average about −18 °C instead of +15 °C.

**Global warming** is the enhancement of this effect by added greenhouse gases: **carbon dioxide** (fossil-fuel burning, deforestation), **methane** (paddy fields, cattle, landfills), **chlorofluorocarbons**, **nitrous oxide** (fertilisers) and water vapour. Their rising concentration tilts the radiation balance so more heat is retained.

**Consequences:** melting glaciers and rising sea level, erratic monsoon and more extreme weather, coral bleaching, shifts in the range of species and crop belts, and threat to island nations.
items.knowledgeNote: CO₂ contributes most of the warming because of its abundance, even though methane is a far stronger absorber molecule for molecule.

items.subject: chemistry
items.question: Classify carbohydrates and explain with one example each the difference between reducing and non-reducing sugars.
items.reference:
**Carbohydrates** are polyhydroxy aldehydes/ketones or their derivatives, classified as monosaccharides (glucose, fructose), disaccharides (sucrose, maltose, lactose) and polysaccharides (starch, cellulose, glycogen).

**Reducing sugars** have a free anomeric (aldehyde/ketal) centre, so they reduce Tollens' and Fehling's reagents — glucose, maltose, lactose.

**Non-reducing sugars** have both anomeric carbons locked in the glycosidic linkage — sucrose; it must first be hydrolysed before it responds to the tests.
items.knowledgeNote: Starch and glycogen are storage polysaccharides of α-glucose; cellulose is structural, built from β-glucose, which is why humans cannot digest it.

items.subject: english
items.question: Write a dialogue between a customer and a bank staff member about opening a savings account (about 8 exchanges).
items.reference:
**Customer:** Good morning. I'd like to open a savings account.
**Staff:** Good morning. Certainly — do you already have an account with us?
**Customer:** No, this is my first account.
**Staff:** Then please bring a citizenship certificate or passport, a PP-sized photograph and a recommendation from a person who has an account here.
**Customer:** Is there a minimum balance?
**Staff:** Yes, Rs 500 must remain in the account. It pays interest twice a year, currently 6%.
**Customer:** Do I get a debit card as well?
**Staff:** Yes, on request — after the account is activated, you can apply for one with no additional charge for the first year.
**Customer:** That sounds good. I'll bring the documents tomorrow.
**Staff:** Please fill in this form and we'll complete everything within a day. Thank you.
items.knowledgeNote: In a dialogue, keep each turn short and realistic; the register must suit the situation — polite and formal at a bank.

items.subject: mathematics
items.question: Evaluate: (a) lim(x→0) sin5x/3x, (b) lim(x→2) (x² − 4)/(x − 2).
items.reference:
**(a)** lim(x→0) sin5x/3x = (5/3)·lim(x→0) sin5x/(5x) = (5/3)(1) = **5/3**, using lim(θ→0) sinθ/θ = 1.

**(b)** 0/0 form, so factorise: (x² − 4)/(x − 2) = (x + 2)(x − 2)/(x − 2) = x + 2 for x ≠ 2. Hence the limit is 2 + 2 = **4**.

The theorem used is that for a rational function the limit at a removable discontinuity is obtained by cancelling the common factor.
items.knowledgeNote: Always try substitution first; if you get 0/0 or ∞/∞, factorise, rationalise or use the standard limit — never divide by zero directly.

items.question: नेपाली संस्कृतिका विशेषता उल्लेख गर्दै यसको जगेर्नाका उपाय लेख्नुहोस्।
items.reference:
**विशेषता:**
१. बहुजातीय, बहुभाषिक र बहुधार्मिक साझा सम्पदा — विविधतामा एकता नेपाली संस्कृतिको मूल विशेषता।
२. सहिष्णुता र सद्भाव — छिमेकी जातजातिबीच सहअस्तित्व।
३. रीतिरिवाज र चाडपर्वको समृद्धि — दसैँ, तिहार, छठ, लोसार, सोनाम ल्होसार आदि।
४. कला, शिल्प र मूर्त-अमूर्त सम्पदा — पगोडा, मूर्तिकला, लोकगीत, भजन।
५. सामान्य ग्रहणशीलता — बाह्य प्रभाव आत्मसात् गर्ने क्षमता।

**जगेर्नाका उपाय:** मातृभाषामा शिक्षा र लेखनलाई प्राथमिकता; स्थानीय चाडपर्व र लोककलाको संरक्षण तथा वैज्ञानिक पुनर्व्याख्या; विश्व सम्पदा क्षेत्रको उचित व्यवस्थापन; कुरीति (दाइजो, छुवाछूत) बहिष्कार गर्दै सकारात्मक पक्ष जोगाउनु; पुस्तान्तरणका लागि किशोरकिशोरीसँग अन्तरक्रिया।
items.knowledgeNote: संस्कृतिको उत्तरमा 'संस्कृति बाँच्ने र बदलिने दुवै क्रम' स्वीकार गर्दा सन्तुलित मानिन्छ।

items.subject: physics
items.question: State Faraday's laws of electromagnetic induction and explain Lenz's law as a consequence of energy conservation.
items.reference:
**Faraday's laws:** (i) whenever the magnetic flux linked with a circuit changes, an emf is induced; (ii) the magnitude of the emf equals the rate of change of flux, |e| = dΦ/dt. For a coil of N turns, e = −N dΦ/dt.

**Lenz's law:** the induced current opposes the change producing it. If it aided the change, the flux would grow without limit and give free energy; the work done against the opposition appears as electrical energy, so Lenz's law is energy conservation in electromagnetic form.
items.knowledgeNote: The minus sign in e = −N dΦ/dt is Lenz's law written mathematically.
